summary: Portable event-backed replica engine plus CRDT-specific adapters.
context_hints: ReplicaEngine owns durability ordering, replay, checkpoint scheduling, and projection offsets.
CRDT versions remain adapter-owned; do not collapse Loro VersionVectors or Yjs state vectors into the engine cursor.
Transport, storage, checkpoint, projection, fan-out, replica-link, and scheduling are ports.
Full Loro snapshots are the safe default. A shallow checkpoint requires a product-owned GC frontier that accounts for admitted offline replicas.

key_files.src/replica-relay.ts: Opaque snapshot/log storage port and cursor page continuity checks; no CRDT runtime.
key_files.src/replica-stream-client.ts: Official Streams SDK append/read/SSE with persist-before-offset and snapshot bootstrap. Cloud checkpoint computation belongs to the Node worker.
key_files.src/loro-stream-session.ts: Browser Loro binding for the Streams SDK: snapshot bootstrap, ordered local appends, remote imports and reconnectable offline edits.

architecture_notes: The narrow ./loro import/types export points to src/loro.ts so native Node 24 checkpoint workers reuse the same adapter without a prerequisite workspace build. Default distribution remains dist/loro.js.
